summary: A chamber editor has to ask committee clerks what happened in rooms the reporter could not reach.
realLife: Floyd Riddick recalled relying on committee clerks for the Daily Digest because only one reporter was assigned to committees whose hearings overlapped.
inGame: needs: committee hearing and a clerk’s account.

turns.what: A second hearing makes the print deadline.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk names a substitute to keep notes.

turns.what: The digest can establish the agenda but not the outcome.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk sends only the notice.
